I answered Tobias in a reply under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot site was **Southgate**.

This comes from Priyanka Sundaram's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. During the outage, Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. After labels were printing again, Southgate cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can read these posts himself.
